summary: Master crisis management in the tourism and hospitality sectors. Join our training course to develop essential skills for effective problem-solving and recovery
lede: Crisis management in tourism and hospitality helps operations leaders prepare for disruptions and protect guests and service continuity. Designed for hospitality and destination professionals, it covers threat and business-impact assessments, evacuation planning, incident coordination, and crisis communications. Learners also develop continuity and recovery plans, assess supplier vulnerabilities, and examine financial exposure during operational downtime.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for leaders and specialists who bear the responsibility of safeguarding operations, guests, and brand reputation during high-stakes disruptions.
modules: Foundations of Tourism Resilience and Risk
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of hospitality operations, destination management, or corporate risk. No prior technical expertise in emergency management or coding is required, though familiarity with basic operational metrics and standard operating procedures (SOPs) is highly recommended.
